errors.text: The proposed 1100–1200 °C SPS window and 10-hour milling duration substantially exceed the target 900–1000 °C and 1–6-hour regimes, increasing the risks of grain coarsening, contamination, and phase decomposition.
The hypothesis invokes controlled displacement rate and thermal-expansion management but provides no numerical displacement-rate constraint or measurable control criterion.

A single 0.5 N indentation test cannot distinguish Hall–Petch grain refinement from solid-solution strengthening; this requires a controlled grain-size series or annealing study with otherwise constant chemistry and phase fractions.
The proposed indentation load is inconsistent with the target 0.05 kN load by a factor of 100.
